# sspi_installer_bundle_local (Resource)

Manages an uploaded local software bundle in the SSPI Depot.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_path` (String) The absolute local path to the bundle file to upload.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the uploaded bundle.
- `package_id` (String) The package ID derived from the uploaded bundle.
- `status` (String) The current status of the uploaded bundle.
- `version` (String) The version of the bundle.
